case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/functional_mixed_effects_inference.py::bootstrap_functional_mixed_effects_coefficients. Native R participant-cluster case bootstrap refits fixed B-spline coefficients by full participant-block GLS while holding reference Gaussian random/residual covariance fixed. Source scientific 9-field FunctionalMixedEffectsBootstrapResult envelope, seeded PCG64 sampling; rejects the older timewise moments path in strict mode.

Accepted source domain: actual previously fitted native joint spline likelihood model with complete participant grouping and full finite fixed/random design, reference covariance invertible, integer n_bootstrap>=100, exactly represented PCG64 seed, no user-supplied sample-draw override in strict mode. Actual native fitted covariance rather than an independent statsmodels refit is conditioned upon.

Existing frozen Python 1.2 direct adapter tests compare participant-level joint GLS resampling coefficients and simultaneous uncertainty under matched native fitted Gaussian covariance and source sample indices. New strict-mode R regression compares all nine scientific fields against full unmodified native result, sampled draw index arrays, coefficient tensor, mean, SD and original source-dataclass field order against frozen Python. Source pinned tests committed, exact-head runs not witnessed green.

Fail closed for moments estimator, no lme likelihood, nonlogical strict flag, R-only externally supplied draw indices, malformed participant groups, singular reference GLS information or per-resample singular systems; frozen Python exact runtime exception class and all precision-boundary behavior are not claimed.

Exactly nine declared frozen Python FunctionalMixedEffectsBootstrapResult scientific fields with real reference, bootstrap_fixed_basis_coefficients, bootstrap_coefficient_functions, sampled_participant_indices, bootstrap_mean, bootstrap_standard_errors, random_state, covariance_conditioning, provenance. Retain native R value identity and source scientific meaning; exclude R-only bootstrap_type and certification flags.

Conditional participant cluster sampling variability of fixed B-spline functional regression under the reference full marginal Gaussian covariance, retaining participant-level whole-trial resampling, never independent timewise moments; same fitted covariance is conditioned on across R and frozen Python source comparison.
